prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Edit the supplied approved illustration into ONE finished portrait 1024x1536 children's coloring page for a four-year-old using thick crayons. Keep the recognizable hedgehog characters, their sizes, emotions, and main action, while simplifying the composition for a tall page with generous white margins. BLACK clean bold smooth outlines only on a PURE WHITE page; all fur, faces, bodies, objects and background interiors remain WHITE for coloring. Use very large closed fillable shapes. Hedgehog quills become a simple scalloped/spiky outer silhouette and only a few large internal clusters; no individual hairs, stippling or tiny quill marks. No gray, shading, gradients, hatching, shadows, colored pixels, pencil texture, decorative border, logo or lettering. No solid black areas except tiny eye pupils and tiny nose centers. Remove ALL source words and numbers. Simplify environment to 2 or 3 iconic outlined props and leave broad open white areas. Maintain distinct complete bodies and natural paws; never fuse a baby into an adult. Scene: Papa the adult hedgehog sits safely on the back of his friendly small dog Scooby, who stands on four paws and turns his head back to meet Papa's eyes. Preserve Scooby's floppy rounded ears, cute long muzzle, curled-up tail, compact body and attentive happy gaze; no photoreal fur. Papa rests one paw near Scooby's shoulder; Papa's seated body is clearly separate from the dog's back. Recompose as a large full-body dog in a gentle diagonal three-quarter view across the lower portrait, with Papa above. All four dog legs and curled tail have simple clean connected contours. Background only the tiny rounded cottage door far behind them and three broad oval stepping stones. Omit all intricate forest foliage, fur texture and stone texture. Large smooth fillable dog-body areas.
visualReview: Passed: bold black outlines, white fill areas, no lettering, readable distinct bodies and faithful action.

readOnlyPixelCheck.note: No pixel processing applied; antialiased line edges and faint raster variation retained in generated original.
